require "$REPO/bench/request_pairs"
root = "$REPO"
app = File.join(root, ".corpus/real-blog-r4")
out = File.join("$OUT", "layer-show")
raise "new output required" if File.exist?(out)
FileUtils.mkdir_p(out, mode: 0o700)
sources = %w[blog_layers.rb blog_check.rb blog_ablation.rb blog_eventful.rb blog_decompose.rb].to_h do |name|
  path = File.join(root, "bench/experiments", name)
  [name, Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest]
end
env = {"RAILS_ENV" => "production", "SECRET_KEY_BASE_DUMMY" => "1", "LOWRAIL" => "0", "RUBYOPT" => nil,
  "RAILS_LOG_LEVEL" => "error", "BENCH_WARMUP" => "50", "BENCH_PIPE" => nil,
  "BENCH_JSON" => nil, "BENCH_PROFILE" => nil, "BENCH_DUMP" => nil}
check = File.join(out, "checks.json")
raise "equivalence failed" unless system(env, RbConfig.ruby, File.join(root, "bench/experiments/blog_ablation.rb"),
  "L2_events", check, chdir: app, out: check + ".log", err: [:child, :out])
variant = Dir.mktmpdir("blog-brk512-events-", File.dirname(app))
begin
  FileUtils.cp_r(Dir[File.join(app, "*"), File.join(app, ".[^.]*")], variant)
  File.write(File.join(variant, "config/initializers/zz_blog_experiment.rb"), <<~RUBY)
    Rails.application.config.after_initialize do
      require #{File.join(root, "bench/experiments/blog_ablation.rb").inspect}
      BlogAblation.install("L2_events")
      warn "BLOG_ABLATION_ACTIVE L2_events"
    end
  RUBY
  environments = {"off_a" => env.merge("BENCH_WORKDIR" => app), "off_b" => env.merge("BENCH_WORKDIR" => app),
    "L2_events" => env.merge("BENCH_WORKDIR" => variant)}
  metadata = {seed: 41231, rounds: 6, workers: {}, specimens: sources}
  accepted = RequestPairs.heap_instructions(environments, app, out, "GET:/articles/1", metadata)
  raise "specimen changed" unless sources.all? do |name, sha|
    Digest::SHA256.file(File.join(root, "bench/experiments", name)).hexdigest == sha
  end
ensure
  FileUtils.remove_entry(variant)
end
exit(accepted ? 0 : 2)
orchestration_sources.guards.rb:
require "$REPO/bench/request_pairs"
root = "$REPO"
base = "$OUT"
preflight = File.join(base, "guard-preflight")
raise "new preflight required" if File.exist?(preflight)
FileUtils.mkdir_p(preflight)
RequestPairs.valgrind_preflight(preflight, {}, app: root, env: {})
%w[interpreter yjit].each do |mode|
  %w[old k].each do |runtime|
    name = "guard-#{runtime}-#{mode}"
    out = File.join(base, name)
    lib = File.join(base, runtime == "old" ? "old-cache" : "k-runtime", "gem/lib")
    env = {"GUARD_JIT" => mode == "yjit" ? "1" : "0", "GUARD_LOWRAIL_LIB" => lib,
      "GUARD_CASES" => "loop,#{runtime == 'old' ? 'cached' : 'inline'}"}
    ok = system(env, RbConfig.ruby, File.join(root, "bench/guard_breakdown.rb"), out,
      out: File.join(base, "#{name}.log"), err: [:child, :out])
    logs = Dir[File.join(out, "*.log")]
    overflow = logs.any? { File.read(_1).match?(/brk segment overflow|Cannot map memory to grow brk segment/) }
    File.write(File.join(out, "brk-control.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(pass: !overflow,
      logs_sha256: logs.to_h { [File.basename(_1), Digest::SHA256.file(_1).hexdigest] }))
    File.write(File.join(out, "exit.json"), JSON.pretty_generate(success: ok, exit_status: $?.exitstatus))
    raise "brk overflow; cohort rejected" if overflow
    puts "#{name}: #{ok ? 'accepted' : 'rejected (retained)'}"
    $stdout.flush
  end
end
